Available on back-order Wuffy Fuzzy Distortion quantity Add to basket Share this product Categories: Distortion / Fuzz , Pedals Tags: distortion , Effects , fuzz , guitar gear , guitar pedals , Pedals , sitek , sitek pedals , stompbox Previous Product Next Product   Description Additional information Controls Videos Warranty Description Once upon a time there was a girl… and then she grew up and befriended a wolf. From then on she ruled the surrounding woods. Wuffy is a powerful Muse that can colour your tone with her loyal friend’s growling any time you need it. Wuffy is a high-gain distortion pedal offering a rich harmonic content, long and creamy sustain, and tones ranging from wooly and dark lows to crispy and piercing highs with additional option to control mids. Whether you need thicker, saturated riffs or cutting solos – she is your girl! With Wuffy you can go anywhere from tamed, mild distortion to more aggressive tones crossing the borderline of distortion and fuzz. This Muse is a 100% discrete analog circuit, designed on four carefully selected gain stages, with high quality components reducing circuit noise even for higher gain settings. Wuffy is suitable for both live and studio applications. *Our pedals are handmade, thus minor imperfections on the enclosure may occur Additional information Weight 0.3 kg Dimensions 11.5 × 6 × 5 cm Controls Smooth-Click™ Footswitch : The pedal is equipped with the DeMont Smooth-Click footswitch – the highest quality footswitch on the market – and provides True Bypass operation. Level : Controls the output volume of the pedal. Drive : Controls the amount of distortion and sustain. Scoop : Controls the amount of mids scoop. Turn clockwise for mid-scooped tone Turn counter-clockwise for fatter mids Tone : Modifies the frequency content of the signal. Turn clockwise for high treble Turn counter-clockwise for deep bass. A slight crackle may occur while adjusting this knob. It’s not a fault. Clipping Switch : Modifies one of the clipping sections by connecting (position II) or disconnecting (position I) the clipping diodes. That provides different harmonic content for both positions, which is more or less prominent depending on the combination of selected guitar pickup and Drive knob setting. Videos Warranty This pedal comes with a 5 year warranty on workmanship and components. If your device suddenly stops working please send us an email at hello@sitek.rocks and we will work it out. Within 5 year the repair will be done free of charge excluding shipping fee. This warranty does not include misuse or accidents resulting in damage.
